fact: On 17 July 2026 South Sudan began enforcing the Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Act 2026 under Presidential Directive No. 03/2026, which establishes a National Cyber-Security Steering Committee chaired by the Minister of Justice and a National Cyber-Security Task Force led by the Internal Security Bureau of the National Security Service.
title: Controversial Cybercrime & Computer Misuse Act 2026 in effect
